goal: Make original project drawings readable and navigable in CEW without changing source or evidence authority.
user_need: A structural engineer must open a drawing, orient it correctly, zoom/pan, understand the whole sheet and move to/from governed evidence without repository knowledge.
required_features: navigate drawing to evidence and back
authority_rules: viewer rotation is display state only
Page/PageTransform/EvidenceRegion are not rewritten by viewer orientation
derived rendering remains reading aid only
visual proximity does not create structural binding
